description: A photograph shows a narrow, grassy embankment separating two highly transformed freshwater ponds, indicative of an aquaculture or fish farming facility. The embankment is covered with green grass, with some taller reedy vegetation growing near the water's edge. In the background, a dense line of green trees forms a forest or woodland boundary. A faint white structure and a tall pole are visible in the distance among the trees. The sky is overcast. The image is credited to "© H. Zytynska / LUCAS, 2009".
